intro: Sevren's Orders are written dispatches penned by Magistrate Sevren of Brill. They direct a proven Forsaken agent to report to Bethor Iceshard, a formidable mage stationed in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.

p: As the Forsaken solidify their grip on the ruins of Lordaeron, skilled agents who have proven their worth against the Scourge in Tirisfal Glades are summoned south to the capital. Issued by Magistrate Sevren, these written orders serve as official introduction and credentials to Bethor Iceshard, one of the Dark Lady's foremost practitioners of the arcane in the Magic Quarter. While Sevren knows little beyond the fact that the assignment involves reaching out to an errant lich, the summons carries the absolute authority of the Undercity's high mages.
